title: Separating Prompt Harmfulness from Interaction Safety via Partial Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16761v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based information systems need safety guardrails. Most guardrails classify the prompt alone. If the prompt looks harmful, the system rejects it before any answer is generated. This is costly. Many rejected prompts would have received a safe response. Users lose help they should have received from the information system. This cost grows as conversational and generative search becomes common. Prompt-level labels treat harm as a property of the query. But harm depends on what the model actually writes. Existing input-output guards do look at responses. But they judge a finished response, so the decision comes after full generation. However, we observe that safety of model interaction with the input prompt can be inferred early with only partial output. translated_title: 通过部分生成将提示词有害性与交互安全性分离
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的信息系统需要安全防护机制。大多数防护机制仅对提示词本身进行分类，如果提示词看起来有害，系统会在生成任何回答之前就将其拒绝。这种做法代价很高：许多被拒绝的提示词本可以得到安全的回答，用户因此失去了本应从信息系统中获得的帮助。随着对话式和生成式搜索的日益普及，这一代价还会持续增长。提示词级别的标注将有害性视为查询本身的属性，但有害性实际上取决于模型实际生成的内容。现有的输入-输出防护机制虽然会查看响应，但它们评判的是已经完成的响应，因此决策发生在完整生成之后。然而，我们观察到，模型与输入提示词交互的安全性可以通过部分输出及早推断出来。因此，系统可以开始生成内容、观察部分响应，只有当内容变得有害时才停止。我们分三步验证这一想法：首先，我们构建了一个包含41,944个提示词-响应对的数据集……
tldr: 该论文提出不再仅凭提示词预先拒绝请求，也不必等待完整生成后再评判，而是通过监控模型的部分生成输出来尽早判断交互安全性，从而在保障安全的同时大幅减少对无害提示词的误拒。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes inferring interaction safety early from partial generation outputs—rather than rejecting prompts upfront or judging fully generated responses—so systems can begin generating and stop only if the content turns harmful, reducing unnecessary rejections while maintaining safety.
